# The Pharmacist

> The Pharmacist is an online pharmacy and healthcare information website.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/): Pharmacy and healthcare services.
- [About us](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/about-us): Information about the organization.
- [All conditions](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/all-conditions): Health condition information and care options.
- [Lifestyle treatments](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/lifestyle-treatments): Lifestyle treatment information.
- [Product shop](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/product): Healthcare products.
- [Find a pharmacy](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/find-pharmacy): Pharmacy search.
- [Contact](https://the-pharmacist.vercel.app/contact): Contact and support information.
